reason: The cited evidence shows that Nb forms strengthening phases in Ni-base superalloys (E2) and that refractory elements improve properties in Ti and Ni alloys (E2), but it does not provide direct evidence for nano-precipitate formation in a Ti-Ni-primary high-entropy alloy, nor for the specific dislocation-pinning mechanism or the matrix phase stability in this unexplored system.
